entries.title: The Glory That Excelleth (1)
entries.text: Tikotamise tose musoro yedu. Hanzi, “...Pane vaviri kana vatatu muZita Rangu, Ini ndiripowo.” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] “Ano gugudza anozarurirwa, [Congregation says, ‘Amen,’] anotsvaka anowana, [Congregation says, ‘Amen,’] anokumbira anopihwa.” [ Congregation says, “Amen.”] “…Regai munhu wese ave murevi wenhema, [Congregation says, ‘Amen,’] asi Mwari vave murevi wezvokwadi…” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Kana une zvaunoda pamberi paMwari, Ishe vanovimbisa kuti vanokupa. [ Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: The Glory That Excelleth (1)
entries.text: Mwari, Shoko Renyu ratiwunganidza pano. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tiri pano muZita raIshe Jesu Kristu. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Confidence dzedu, kurovererwa kwamakaita pamchinjikwa, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] Mwari nekuziva kuti Rugwaro rinoti, “No weapon manufactured against you, shall prosper…” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Baba dai maitiitira nyasha pakuungana kwataita. [ Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mwari tinoisa, vese vari mukati meimba ino, muMaoko Enyu manheru ano. [ Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mumwe nemumwe ane chaakumbira mumwoyo wake, [ Congregation says, “Amen,”] vamwe vasimudza maoko avo.. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Havana kusimudza kumunhu nokuti vanoziva kuti munhu haana zvaanagona kuvapa. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Vasimudza kwamuri Musimboti wedu. Chiitai nyasha Mwari wekururama. [Congregation says, “Amen\yes Lord.”]

entries.title: The Glory That Excelleth (1)
entries.text: Taikumbirawo panguva imwe chete iyo Baba wakanaka kuti mubatsire, Baba mhuri yaBrother Dube, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] panguva ino inguva yakaoma fani kwavari. [ Congregation says, “Amen.”] Taingotarisa Ruoko Rwenyu pavari, itai nyasha Baba. [ Congregation says, “Amen.”] Taikumbirawo zvakare Baba wakanaka kuti kana tichava, tichava nekufamba kwatichaita, panyaya yerufu irworu titungamirei mazviri. [ Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hwurongwa hwedu hweweekend, hwebasa, titungamirireiwo mazviri. [ Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: The Glory That Excelleth (1)
entries.text: Tinotenda nekudoka kwaita zuva. [ Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tinoisa vatsvene, Baba makanaka, vapenyu, vari kurwara, tiine pfungwa yaMai Nehohwa, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] Baba tichitenda nezvavakaita. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tiine pfungwa yaSister Nyaude, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] kuti Baba tinotumira Shoko roruponeso. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Chiitai ngoni pano patiri pano. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndiri kukumbira Ruoko Rwenyu Mwari wakarurama, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] tsiye dzenyu nyoro kuti dzive dzinova patiri. [ Congregation says, “Amen.”] Baba tinotsuura Satani, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] tinotsuura kusanamata kwese. [ Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: The Glory That Excelleth (1)
entries.text: Chibatsirai Mwari wakarurama, mutibatsire papfungwa dzenyu dzatinounganira pano. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ruoko Rwenyu ngaruvewo nesu, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] rwutitungamirire Baba wakanaka pakuchinja nzvimbo ino, from residential to commercial, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] tiri kukumbira nyasha dzenyu pazvese. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Uyezve tinoda mari yekuvaka pano. [ Congregation says, “Amen.”] Baba makati, “Anokumbira anopihwa, [ Congregation says, ‘Amen,’] anotsvaka anowana, [ Congregation says, ‘Amen,’] anogugudza anozarurirwa.” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tinotenda nekutipa kwamuri kuita. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Baba tinoziva kuti no one can outgive God, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] tikuwedzerei Mwari wakanaka. [ Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: The Glory That Excelleth (1)
entries.text: Tinotenda nekufamba kwatinoita mimigwagwa nguva nenguva, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] tsiye dzenyu nyoro dzichititarisira. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Baba chibatsirai Mwari wakarurama, muve nevatsvene vari kudiaspora, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] vatsvene vari across the border, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] Baba mova nekuronga kwese kwatinako. Baba pamusoro pazvose, dzoreredzai Mwenga Wenyu. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mwenga Wenyu Baba wakarurama, nd’owatine tarisiro nawo, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] kuti udzorerwe panzvimbo yawo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Taikumbira Ishe nekuisa service ino Mumaoko Enyu. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Kudzwai, namatwai nekusingaperi, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] muZita raTenzi Jesu Kristu, Amen, and Amen. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: The Glory That Excelleth (1)
entries.text: Aiwa tinokwazisana zvakare muZita raTenzi Jesu Kristu. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tichiti tizivisane, ndofunga tese tava kuziva kuti, Br Dube vakashayika. Saka ta’tichifanira kunge taenda kuno vachengeta nhasi dai hurongwa hwedu hwatanga tiinahwo, hwanga hwafamba zvakanaka, but mai vavo vazouya, masikati. Hama dzakanga dzatora burial order muzita ra... (Inaudible 0:03:36.4). Brother Dube vanga vaine rimwe zita kuJoni nerimwe birth certificate. Kuno uku vanga vaine rimwe zita ratinoziva. Saka mai vacho vakati mwana wangu haavigwe as a South African, anovigwa se a Zimbabwean (Inaudible 0:03:52.6 - 0:03:54) ...unozeza. Saka vana Brother vabva vangobvako makuseni tikati kana mazopedza, vakati ingouyai nevazukuru. Vazukuru vacho vazouya manheru, anaya, kuWaterfalls vakati vasangana naPastor Chuma kuWaterfalls kwavanga vachiti ivo tatichikumbirawo kuti muchitibatsirawo, pa…box netransport. Isu ta’tagara hedu tichida kubatsira hama iyi. Saka ndangovati haa, tinovabatsira mangwana. Tangomirira kuona kuti mangwana acho, chii chichaitika.

entries.title: The Glory That Excelleth (1)
entries.text: Saka most likely tichada dzimwe hama, kunyanya hama dzechikuru handitika, kuti vaende kunochengeta Brother Dube… (Inaudible 0:4:32). Majaya ese nemamwewo mabrotherwo, tinogona kusara, tichienda kupi...? kumunda, kuti tikwanise kuunganidza eh… (Inaudible 0:4:46 – 0:04:49). Saka unfortunately, program yedu (Inaudible 0:4:51 – 0:04:52). But ngatinamatirei Sister Dube nevana vavo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Vari panguva yakaoma chai...? [Congregation says, “chaizvo,”] chaizvo. Havawirirane navaambuya vavo, whatever the (Inaudible 0:05:00.5). Saka havawirirane zvacho...? zvachose. Saka ngativanyengetererei period yavari mairi ipfuu...? ipfuure. Ndochikumbiro chatiinacho.

entries.title: The Glory That Excelleth (1)
entries.text: Saka ngatiendei mberi nekunamatira Sister Nehohwa naSister Nyaude nhaika? Ehe. Sister Nyaude vanga vachi...Tazoudzwa nemurume wavo kuti inenge, the same infection inoita munhu after delivery yakaita Sister Dzoro iya, but kuno uku haina kuonekwa nekuku...? nekukurumidza. Saka, we trust by God's grace kuti ipere handitika? Then hama yanga ichiti kana vakamuka vari right mangwana, vanoda munamato handitika. Vada kumbomhanya kuJoni kunotsvaga chokuraramisa. Saka varangarirei manheru ano nhai ka? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Saka Mwari akuitirei nyasha chai...? [Congregation says, “chaizvo,”] chaizvo mese, nekuuya muimba yaMwari.

entries.title: The Glory That Excelleth (1)
entries.text: Now we have started late today. Taatichiisa malights aya, akanaka ka aya? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Saka ndaida kuti hama dzitiisire magetsi aya, tikwanise kutora video yedu, zvakanaka. Yatakatanga kutora didn't come out...nice. Yanga iri dark. So, we were busy. Saka nezuro ndakatora aya, malights aya, tikaisa aya but aya mukuona aya ari dull ka aya? Light ranga riri weak, saka hama yazowana chaizvo chaizvo zva-zvi-zvinonyatsoita. [Apostle chuckles] Saka munhu nemunhu ane nzvimbo yake handitika? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Saka takanga tichiti nezuro haa, magetsi aya haana kunaka, dai tawana ane double. Ivo vazoenda vakazowana rine four manje, handi’moona? Saka this one is good.

entries.title: The Glory That Excelleth (1)
entries.text: So, if we could get another one there handitika, tikawana rimwe apo, the whole church would be brighter handitika? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ehe, then towanirwa rimwe one chete, rimwe one kuback uku we’ll be okay. Saka ndatofunga kuti aah, ngatichigadzirai church yedu zvakanaka, kaite kachurch...Tichavakirwa naBrother Satiya kumberi uku handitika, platform yakanaka, toisirwa kana pavement so, kakanaka and then toisirwa mawindow one, two, three. Toita one, two, three, toisa ceiling, nemafan handitika? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] I think that way it will be a nice church. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Yeah, inenge ya’a church yakanaka chai...? [ Congregation says, “chaizvo,”] tomboshandisa yakadii...? [ Congregation says, “yakadaro,”] yakadaro, handiti? Saka ngatikumbirei Mwari, Mwari vatipe nyasha.

entries.title: The Glory That Excelleth (1)
entries.text: Zvinhu zvinoda mari zvakawanda pakati pedu, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] hatimbozvipedzi handi’moona? Saka ngatikumbirei kuti...hatiregerei kunyara kukumbirira mari. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] But mari yatinokumbira ngaive, yeku…simudzira basa raMwari. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ehe. Hatidi vanhu vanokumbira mari, dzavo handitika? Like I always say, handi moona. Handi’moona, mukaona, nobody knows how tomorrow will be, nobody does. Who—did you think Brother Dube knew kuti, he would go yesterday? Muri kuzviona? Ndosaka chinhu chikuru muhupenyu kudii...? kunamata. Izvezvi wakagara ipapapa, uine confidence uchinyeya vamwe, wakaviga zvivi handitika, unogona kunge usipo by the month end yaJune. Don't you think it’s wiser, kuti hukama hwako naMwari hunge hwakadii...? [Congregation says, “hwakanaka,”] hwakanaka. Nobody knows where he will be tommorrow ha’moona.

entries.title: The Glory That Excelleth (1)
entries.text: Ndosaka unogona kuzviunganidzira...Ndaitaura nehanzvadzi after the service ya...handi-ndi-ndaitaura nasister ani, I think vandaiudza ndikati sister, ndofunga ndiSister Busi handiti? Ehe ndiSister Busi vandaitaura navo. Saka we were talking about life, then vachinditi, vachinditi, “Haa ini kana ndichida kuroorwa inini mumarriage ndoda security. I look into security, that's what I look for into marriage, I look into security.” Ndikavati, “Sister, what security do you look for muma...? mu marriage?” So, it's a man with money handitika? With a car, with a house handiti? But is that security? You see? What people think is security, is not security. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Then I said to her ndikati, “Sister Busi, security munayo kudha...? kudhara. Security yamunayo ndiJeso wamakagamuchira.” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndosecurity huru iyo...? [Congregation says, “iyoyo,”] iyoyo handi’moona.

entries.title: The Glory That Excelleth (1)
entries.text: Many people have wondered why I have given...Ndaitaura ndikati, many people have wondered why I have given this place kuti iite church handi’moona. Now, I stand to lose everything that I own, if I die tomorrow. Munozviziva izvozvo? Mm. Zvotorwa nababa wako, zvotorwa nehanzvadzi yako, zvotorwa nemunin'ina wako, vana vako vakatozosara vakatambura. But chawapa kuna Mwari, hachitoreki. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] handi’moona.

entries.title: The Glory That Excelleth (1)
entries.text: Saka hakuna Brother vanozoti, Tito kana akange ari rombe vamudzinge pana apa. Moziva kuti hazvifi zvakaitika? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Vanofana kuti, “Ah, Baba vake ndoovaive founder me...? [Congregation says, ‘member.’] member. Ari kungorara pachechi ipapo mupfana iyeye Baba vake vaive… ndiye—ndiye aive Apostle wacho weipapapa Baba vacho, but mupfanha uyu hameno kuti akaita sei, hm?” Ende hakuna kana hama yangu inombofunga kana kubata nzvimbo iyi. Saka if there is a thing that I have guaranteed for my children, is what I have given to the Lord. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: The Glory That Excelleth (1)
entries.text: Handi’muri kuzviona manje? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] But imba yemuKadoma unogona kunzwa kuti Innocent aitora akaitengesa. Benz unonzwa kuti yatorwa namai vangu chaivo, mugoshaya kuti komuchembere uya Benz hachaidi, achaidii? Yatotorwa. But zvandinenge ndakati ndezveChechi, [Apostle claps his hands five times] nobody will take, nekuti imi munenge mazvinzwira kuti ah-ah izvi Past—Apostle vakatiudza kuti ndezvechii...? [Congregation says, “ndezve Chechi.”] This is the Church! Ende isusu taivakawo panapa. Hama dzangu dzinobva dzadaiwo, [Apostle demonstrates] but you can never say that kuimba yekuKadoma. Mai Tito vanoburitswa, Mai Kim vanoburitswa. Eddimore anohedhuka uyu, musi wandinofa. [Congregation laughs]. Ndopamunozoona kuti hamusi mose zvachose. [Apostle chuckles] Haa, vaakutaura kuti, “Inini haaa, inini haaa, mm, hapana zvandingaite ini ndiri chii...? ndiri mwana.” Handi’moona, akatarisawo Mazda iyi iri apo isiri kufamba iyo, kuti pamwe ndoyandichakakatawo nda’akubva pano. [Apostle laughs.]

entries.title: The Glory That Excelleth (1)
entries.text: Munhu nemunhu anenge aine chake chaakatarisa, “Ahh ndikabva panapa ndisina kana Toyota, huh? Ahhh, ndobuda nechinhu chete.” Mukuona zviri vanhu venyama? Zvinobvarurwabvarurwa zvese. Dzimwe hama dzangu dzamusingazive dzinouya pano kuti, “Sekuru ndaivaziva but ndandisina kumbouya hangu panapa.” Anenge achida bhutsu chete. “Ndakanzwa kuti sekuru vangu vakanga vakapfuma chaizvo, asi tinepfekerana chete, ndikapuhwawo bhutsu yangu.” Mumwe anouya achida iyo sutu iyoyi iyi. Ndiudzei kuti munhu abva kuKenzamba akapuhwa sutu yakadai, ah! Ndoyaanoshandisa kwese kwaachaenda kwese ndiyo yaanoshandisa kupfeka sutu iyoyi. Iye pachake wanga asingagone kuitenga.

entries.title: The Glory That Excelleth (1)
entries.text: Ndopandakabata kuti chinhu chaunoti ndechako, chinogona kusava chako mangwa…? [Congregation says, “mangwana.”] Hm. Brother Dube musi wavashaya chaiwo vaitoti kumwana wavo, “Iwe haikona kundidhonza gumbo uri kundirwadzisa gumbo iri.” Kamwana kacho ndobva kafinyama kumeso kuti… [Apostle demonstrates.] Zvikanzi, “Unenge mbuya vako vari kuda kutora Benz—B—BM yangu. Manje mbuya vako BM yangu havaidii…? havaiwani.” That’s a brand-new car and look what happened this morning. This morning Brother ku-ku-Hokonya vaedza kuimu…? Yaramba kumuka BM. [Apostle laughs] He. Yaramba kumuka. Ini ndaitoitarisa Monday manheru ndikaona iri kungoburitsa oyiri kuexhaust uku, ndikati ahh! Mota iyi inyo…? [Congregation says, “inyowani,”] inyowani iri kurutsa oiri kuexhaust uku, kununira exhaust vanhu vaMwari. He. Munhu waMwari akataura kuti mota yangu mbuya handidi kuti vaidii…? [Congregation says, “vaitore,”] vaitore, iyo yaramba kumuka iyo.

entries.title: The Glory That Excelleth (1)
entries.text: Zvino Brother Sinclair vanga vaakuda kugadzira ndikati, “Eh eh eh eh eh! [Congregation laughs.] Mambopedza dzakafa dzese dziri pano kwamunobata iyoyi nyowani?” Ndikati, ndikati, “[Apostle laughs] Endai munogadzira uko, dzakawanda dzakafa panapa, iyi siyanai nani…?” [Congregation says, “nayo.”] Imota nyowani futi Benz iyi, eh, moibata moivhura kumberi uku, inotoita worse. Leave it! Ingoipakai ipapo pairi ipapo, handi’moona. But unotonyatsoona kuti manje ka…Munoziva kuti munhu anogona kugumbuka, mweya wake kungogumbuka ikoku zvinhu zvake zvose zvikapa…? [Congregation says, “zvikaparara.”] Hapana chinombonzi chivanhu kana chikaranga chiripo.

entries.title: The Glory That Excelleth (1)
entries.text: Ndosaka, kana zvinhu wakazviwana munyasha, vabereki vako vari n’anga kana mudzimu, vakada kuzvitora, zvinongotsakatika kupera kudai [Apostle claps seven times.] The bad thing is, nobody benefits, your children don’t, your wife doesn’t, those things are go…? [Congregation says, “are gone,”] are gone. So, what will survive? That which you have given to God. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Zvawapa kuna Mwari zvinodii…? [Congregation says, “zvino surviv-ha.”]

entries.title: The Glory That Excelleth (1)
entries.text: Ndosecurity, kupa kuna Mwari, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] handi’moona ehe. Ndosecurity huru chaiyo chaiyo iyo iyoyo, zvawapa kuna Mwari…Mukaona Bhaibheri richitaura kuti, “…you cannot out give God…”, “you cannot outgive God,” handi’moona. What does the Bible mean, huh? Zvese zvawakapa Mwari, pawunenge waakudenga wane hupenyu hunyu—husingaperi handitika, uchaona kuti hapana comparison iri…? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hapana comparison iripo. Ha’moona. Uchaona kuti hapana kana chandakaita, handi’moona. Suffering yose yawakaita muna Mwari, persecution yese yawakaita muna Mwari, kutambura kwose kwawakaita muna Mwari, kana taapakuenda kumusoro kudenga, uchaona kuti haaa, ndofunga ndaifanira kurohwa worse kudarika zvandakaitwa zviya, ndaifanira kuyedzewa worse kudarika zvandakaitwa zviya, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] waakuona glory yezvauchadii…? zvauchapihwa. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: The Glory That Excelleth (1)
entries.text: Ndosaka munhu wese ari pano, while we are praying for a double portion this year, tichinamatira double portion gore rino iri, munamato mukuru ndewokuti Mwari, tisevenzesei pakudzoreredzwa kweMwenga. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Muri kupabata ipapo vanhu vaMwari, handiti? I don’t want you to forget that.

entries.title: The Glory That Excelleth (1)
entries.text: That’s why this year, Mwenga wanyadzisa vanhu vaMwari aah! Mwenga ndinonyara kana inini kuti…Vakomana tingagare chokwadi, vakomana takatarisa…I was shocked, ndichi…fonerwa naMother. Zvikanzi naMother, “Nhai Baba Shiphra, pane chakaipa here ukanyorera annointed water yekuEmmanuel?” What do you think I said? Pane chakaipa here kutora annointed water yekuEmmanuel? Pane chakaipa here kutora annointed water yekuEmmanuel? Hatinzwei. Ndikutaura nevanhu vakuru. [Congregation laughs.] Pane chakaipa here kutora annointed water yekuEmmanuwero? [Congregation says, “ehe / mm-hmm.”] Hm? [Congregation says, “mm-hmm / Amen.”] Pane chakaipa? [Congregation says, “Amen / mm-hmm.”]

entries.title: The Glory That Excelleth (1)
entries.text: Vam—horaiti, apa pari kunetsa. [Congregation laughs.] Vanoti pane chakaipa kutora Emmanu—annointed water yekuEmmanuwero hationeyi maoko enyu, vanoti pane chakaipa? Right. Hatiisei pasi. Vanoti hapana chakaipa? Right. Ini ndinoti pane chakaipa. Why would a person ari muMessage, achidzokera kuzvinhu zviri pasi? Huh? Ko imo mu Message macho, kana annointed water riri Shoko raMwari, imi hamuiti yenyu? Inongozo kuporesai yabva kuEmmanuel?

entries.title: The Glory That Excelleth (1)
entries.text: Saka ndakati kuna Mother, ndikati, “Mother, muri mai va—Mai Mufundisi. Kana imi muchidai neannointed water yekuEmmanuel, kuzoti makwayi, anoda annointed water akawanda zvakadii?” Annointed water yekuEmmanuwero, ndeyeku Emmanuwero. Ko isu hatiiti anointed water kana tichiida pano? But inini I would never do things like annointed water, nekuti handina kwandakazviona muporofita achizvidii…? [Congregation says, “achizvitaura/achizviita.”] Chandinoziva inini, ndoziva kunamatira pla-prayer cloth. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: The Glory That Excelleth (1)
entries.text: Ende nyaya yekunamatira mvura, origin yayo iPostori. Inhema here vanhu vaMwari? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Zvokunamatira mvura hamuzvizivi? [Congregation says, “tozviziva.”] Why take yekuEmmanuel? Ndodaku—ingoenda pana…paPostori upuwe uuye nebhodhoro rako. Unoda yekuNigeria ko yemuno haizi mvura? Inongonamatirwa zve. MaPostori akabvira kudhara achinamatira mvura, vanotomwiza mvura kuti mumudhuri yedzimba, handiti? Why take yekuEmmanuel? Ko iyi, iPostori.

entries.title: The Glory That Excelleth (1)
entries.text: Now mukatarisa ministry yaBrother T.B Joshua, handitika, origin yayo ndiyo…? I—i background yePostori, handi’maona. Hongu ine masaramusi, hongu ine zvishamiso handitika? Ende ministry dzine background yezi-ye-yePostori, ma—zvishamiso zvakanyanyisa. Handizivi kuti chinokushamisai pazvishamiso chii, because maPostori ese anoita chishamiso. Hakuna kumbodzuurwa zvinhu? Hakuna kumbodzuurwa zvinhu nemaPostori?

entries.title: The Glory That Excelleth (1)
entries.text: But munhu ari muMessage, faith yake haisi mamiracle. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tingaita Ameni here ipapa hama. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Faith yako iwewe, iri paShoko rinoti, “… you shall know the…? [Congregation says, ‘the truth,’] and the truth…,” [Congregation says, “shall set you free.”] Or is it, you shall see miracles, and miracles shall save you? You shall see miracles ende miracles will reveal the Word of God to you? “Many shall come unto me and say, we cast out devils in Your Name, we prayed for the sick and they were what…? and I shall say unto them depart from, me you worker of iniquity.” [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: The Glory That Excelleth (1)
entries.text: Ende sign huru yekuti munhu anotenda Shoko raMwari handitika, sign huru panyika pano yekuratidza kuti munhu anotenda Shoko raMwari ibarika. Ukaona munhu asingatende barika, handina basa nekuti anomutsa vakafa kana kuti anodii. Hapurakatapra anozviita. Handina basa navo, kunyangwe akakunamatira ukamera gumbo nyuwani. [Congregation laughs] But kana…kunyangwe aka… (Inaudible 0:19:45 – 0:19:46) kana asingatendi Marriage and Divorce, handiti, I’ll walk out, heh. Nokuti Mwari akati kumurume anonzi Dhavhidha, “a man after My own heart.” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Huh! Imagine, Dhavhidha aine vakadzi five hundred, akanzi naMwari murume wandinoda chai…? [Congregation says, “chaizvo,”] chaizvo.

entries.title: The Glory That Excelleth (1)
entries.text: Ndosaka nanhasi wese, ini ndinotenda kuti barika it’s a sign yekuti munhu a—haikona kuri tambira nekuti wamanikidzwa kana kuti waiswa pakona, but chizaruro chai…? [Congregation says, “chaicho.”] Why do I think like that? Have you ever seen a-a Word, Shoko, rinowirirana vanhu vanoenda kuchechi nevari munyika kuti hatiride? Where have you ever seen that? Ndorega randakaona panyika pano, rokuti unoenda munyika unonzwa vachiti hatidi, woenda kuvanhu vanonamata, Christian world yose, unonzwa ichiti futi hai…? [Congregation says, “haidi,”] haidi! Chetechete! Baptism in the name of the Father, Son, and Holy Ghost ine vanoida, ine vasingaidi. Baptism in Jesus’ Name ine vanoida, ine vasingaidi, but barika, even muno, muChurch medu muno, vamwe havaridi.

entries.title: The Glory That Excelleth (1)
entries.text: Ndozvanda’chitaura masikati nemasisters, ndikati masisters ese, kuti tinyatsouraya mweya uyu, ini handidi, handidi kugara nemunhu asingadi barika, handimude. Ndochokwadi chizere because ndoziva kuti imbewu yei…? [Congregation says, “yenyoka”] yenyoka. Saka toda kuti munhu wese, jaya rese rinofanira kutanga ratenga imba, ronyatsoita i—mari, ende brother vose vanoroora two, one time. [A brother says, “Amen.”] Ndodoctrine nyowani. [Congregation laughs.] Gainmore kana achida kuroora, akarais-a mari yemunhu one, handitika, handidi kumuona. Tumichato tunenge twaana Brother Chigova netwaana aMupa, netwaana cha—Nyaude pano, hatichatuda tumichato itwotwo. [Congregation laughs.] Twumichato tunosimbisa vanhu muzvinhu zvokusanamata Mwari. Hatichada tumunamato, ini handichada kutambisa Saturday yangu ndiri pakamunama—ka-kamuchato kakaita sekaya, handichadi! [Congregation laughs.] Ndichirwisana neShoko raMwari every day. Izvozvo handichada izvozvo izvo, handi’moona. Twumuchato… (Inaudible 0:21:51.9) …wotorova cut, vahedheni vese vanenge vachidaiwo vachifara.

entries.title: The Glory That Excelleth (1)
entries.text: Mukaona vakadzi vari muChurch medu vasingadi barika, maona mafariro avanoitaka pamichato yevafanha ava? Munhu—pandakaona Mai…eh…Mai Banda, vachifara, kujamba kudaiwo, kusvotesa Brenda uyu, na…na…nani? naPami uyu naMai Bati ava, kuti imi makaitirei barika, honai zvinoita vana vevamwe. Mai Runyowa, takavaona vachifara kudai. Makavaona? Mai Runyowa havaseki. [Congregation laughs.] MuChurch vanenge vakangodai… [Apostle demonstrates] Fanika ini ndikangomira apa waona… [Apostle demonstrates.] [Congregation laughs.]

entries.title: The Glory That Excelleth (1)
entries.text: Saka mabrother ese, ndoda—handidi—anongouya achindiudza kuti ada kuroora, hapachisina mubvunzo wokuti uda kuroora ani. Ukati ndoda kuroora ndoti, “Vanani?” [Congregation laughs.] Kana une one, get away! [Congregation laughs.] Ndosign yakanaka iyoyo, munhu wese anofana kuuya aine vanhu vekuroora kwete munhu. Anyone anongouya achitaura kuti ndoda kuroora munhu, chete one, you are an unbeliever. Ehe. Unofanira kuuya uchiti, “Pastor ndauya kuzotaura zvekuroora.” Ehe. Ndoti, “Vana ani?” Wotaura kuti, “Ndoda kuroora nhingi nani…?” [Congregation says, “nanhingi.”] Ndoti, “Haa horaiti ka munhu waMwari. Ma—maanemba ka imi?” “Ehe.” “Kune furniture yakanaka?” “Ehe.” “Saka one anopinda mumba, one modi…? morojera. But for the time being sezvo mune imba yenyu yamatenga, handitika, kana vari two munombogara henyu makada…? [Congregation says, “makadaro,”] makadaro. Torai.”

entries.title: The Glory That Excelleth (1)
entries.text: Toda kutanga—ndoda kutanga kuorganis-a muchato, the next wedding inoitwa pano, mupfanha anenge ari pakati apa vanhu two vachiteera vakadai. [Congregation laughs.] Ndokuti… (Inaudible 0:23:31.3) … Handichade michato iyoyo futi iyoyo, handichade, handichada handichada kuiona. Munhu wese ada kubvumidza izvozvozvo. Ndakatoona kuti ahh, ndini ndiri kutorwisa, ndiri kurwisana nezvandinotenda. Ndiri kupembedza vanhu vasi…? vasingatende Shoko rani…? [Congregation says, “raMwari.”] Pana apa handichade ini. Munhu wese anoroora mukadzi one, i right right, munhu anoroora vakadzi vaviri, opon. Saka munhu wese anongoroora one, mumba mangu, kuback uku ku—ndotokuremekedza ndokuchatisira mucream raunji, zvakanaka naka. Ndoti huyai mupinde henyu brother, uyai uyai uyai. Then nemabrother two nemadzimai avo. Even vane barika vanouya ne one one nekuti iwe une one zve. Zvino imagine munhu ane vakadzi seven achijamba jamba pamuchato wemunhu ane mukadzi one, ndendichiitei?

entries.title: The Glory That Excelleth (1)
entries.text: Saka munhu wese, anoda kuroorwa, kana masister edu, da’kuti masister edu asingadi barika abve. Vanhu vasinga…? [Congregation says, “vasingade.”] Cause here’s the dangerous thing that will happen. These sisters, unomuona akagara muChechi muno. Munoziva kuti masisters vano apa, barika havaridii…? havaride, but anoramba akavandira. Anoziva kuti ndichawana wangu. Kana ndawana wangu ndichamugadzira, kuti arege kudii…? kuwedzera. Saka unoona dzinoramba dzakadaiwo. [Apostle illustrates] Mm. “Barika, haa tinotenda barika.” Wonzwa, “Amen, tinotenda barika, Amen.” Akange angoroorwa manje nani…? naBrother Godhi, Brother Godhi vokanikiwa. [Congregation laughs.]

entries.title: The Glory That Excelleth (1)
entries.text: Taruza hama dzakawanda. Mukaona, takachengeta Mai Musharu, havadi barika, tochengeta Mai Runyowa, havadi barika, takachengeta Mai Kugedera vakuru, havadi barika, handiti? Then takachengeta eh…Mai Mukodzi, havadi barika, takachengeta Mai Mure—Mudekwa. Chakadzingisa Mai Mudekwa it’s because Mudekwa anga akuita move yekutora Rhoda. Muri kuzviona? He. Musharu akanga aita m-move yekutora Christina, Mukodzi anga aakutora Stella, nechiramu chake ichi, Tsitsi. Anga achida futi kutora mudzimai aive mudzimai waBrother Musasa, handi munozviziva? Vakadzi vacho ndobva vawona kuti ah, barika panapa riri kufamba nespeed yakati, ndokukanika, handi’moona.

entries.title: The Glory That Excelleth (1)
entries.text: Saka ini I don’t mind, mabrother akakanikiwa. Ini ndoziva kuti, “There is no weapon manufactured against you shall prosper…” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Saka kana zvakashanda ndezvani izvo…? [Congregation says, “ndezvako,”] zvako. Haizi mhosva yangu ini, but ndoda manje, jaya, vasikana vandoda kupastor, ndoda vasikana vanongogara vakagamuchira barika. Muri kuona Precious uyu? Mai vake vakafa vasingade kuti aende pabarika uyu. Vaiti tsvaga jaya, ndozvavakamudzidzisa, ende iye waiteerera izvo…? [Congregation says, “izvozvo,”] izvozvo. Saka chindiudzai kuti mukamuregera akaenda pajaya, jaya rino roora futi? Vasikana ava vanenge vachiti tinoda barika, tinoda barika vari muno umu, but vakange vangoroorwa nemasingle brothers, handitika, vojoina korasi yemadzimai asingadi chii…? [Congregation says, “barika,”] barika.

entries.title: The Glory That Excelleth (1)
entries.text: Zvino ndiudzei, ndosaka mukawona, masisters edu ese pano, mazhinji acho, izvozviso kutaura kudai, muri kuona kuti vane varume one one so vese unoona kuti mu mu mu. Ndi’kuona Mai Chigova apo. [Apostle speaks to Brother Chigova in the next statement.] Mukaona face yemudzimai wenyu munorohwa nehana. [Apostle and Congregation laughs]. Mukazvinonokera izvi, handitika, hamuwedzere imi. Hama iyi ka iyi handiti. Manje hama iyi ine dzimba, handitika, nemotokari, yakaroorerei mukadzi one hama iyi? Ende kubva zvayaroora sister ava haina kuzombodzoka futi nanhasi yakangoti duzu. Brother vakuvara ava handiti? [Apostle and Congregation laugh.] Aiwa kufara hangu.

entries.title: The Glory That Excelleth (1)
entries.text: But maqualification ese vana…? [Congregation says, “vanawo.”] Why didn’t he take another one? Moona—handi’moona kuti vacho vane maqualification havatauri nenyaya yacho. That brother doesn’t believe the Word of God. If he believed the Word of God, ane dzimba mbiri handiti, ane purazi kuMhondoro, handitika, ane motokari mbiri, furniture anayo ka…? [Congregation says, “kare.”] Ari kutochengeta Nyaude nemukadzi wake mumba mani…? Saka iye ane one sei? Sei Chigova aine one? Handi’moona kuti zviri pachena kuti Chigova ariku—ukamubvunza kuti ko une one sei, haana tsananguro. “Hamuna mari here?” “Mari ndakasiigwa.” “Imba munayo here?” “Ehe.” “Pastor venyu vakati munhu anoroora rinhi?” “Kana atenga imba, anoroora mukadzi wechipiri.” “Ko iwe uneyi?” “Ndine mbiri dzimba.” “Saka sei usiri kuroora?”

entries.title: The Glory That Excelleth (1)
entries.text: Degree anaro. Muri kuzviona kuti slowly, imi makagara mubenji umu, imi barika hamuridii…? hamuritendi. Saka nda’akuti munhu ngaanyengetere hama. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Change of status iyi, it’s a must to everybody. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mapaona? Haizi nyaya yekuti inofanira kuva yekutamba, aiwa. Brother ngavasvike papoint yekuti vanobvunza vega kuti, “Nhai Pastor, zvandadai mungandirambidzewo kuroora here?” Hautaure kuti, “Ndoda kuroora”. Ehe.

entries.title: The Glory That Excelleth (1)
entries.text: “Zvandadaiwo Pastor mungandirambidzewo kuroora? Ndakatenga two room yangu kuKuwadzana, ende ndiri kuda kuroora madzimai angu maviri but, pandinenge ndichitoroora madzimai angu maviri, ndiri kutowedzera room yechitatu.” [Congregation laughs].

entries.title: The Glory That Excelleth (1)
entries.text: Ndoshamwari dzangu idzodzo, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] nokuti iyoyo ndiyo sign yeShoko raMwari chai…? [Congregation says, “chaiyo.”] Haa, ini kutaura chokwadi munhu anoda mukadzi one ini handidi kutamba naye ini. [Congregation laughs.] Mukadzi wake anokuvenga, anofunga kuti uri kumufurira, handiti muri kuzviona? Iwe kana uine vakadzi seven, Mai Chatukuta vakaona ndichi—naBrother Chatukuta imi mofunga kuti vanofara? Monzwa vachiti, “Mu-mufarise, izvo zvokuenda kuDRC, mari yenyu yamuri kuuya nayo pano haizi kukwana. Ndiri kuona muchingosekererana naPastor every day.” [Apostle and Congregation laughs].

entries.title: The Glory That Excelleth (1)
entries.text: Ndosaka masister aya, ndokuvaworora masister aya. [ A brother says, “yeah.”] Ehe. Unosvika uchiti inini, [Congregation laughs,] ndaakuda kuroora. Ehe, ndaakuda kuroora brother ehe, ndoda kuroora sister. “Eh, ndandichifunga kuti mungade here kuita mudzimai wangu?” Handitika? Ehe. And masister edu ngaagare akaziva kuti handinyengwe ndiri o…? [Congregation says, “ndiri one.”] Ehe vanobva vabvunza kuti, “Ko mumwe wangu ndi…? [Congregation says, ‘ndiani,’] ndiani?” [Congregation laughs.] Ndoomubvunzo watakuda kubva mumuromo wemasisters edu.

entries.title: The Glory That Excelleth (1)
entries.text: Kuti, “Zvamandivinga ko mumwe wangu ndi…? [Congregation says, ‘ndiani,’] ndiani?”. Ukavinga Boni ngaabvunze kuti mumwe wangu ndiani. Woti, “Nda’ndakuremekedzai ndatanga kuuya kwamuri. Imi munofunga kuti wamunogona kugarisana naye ndi…? [Congregation says, ‘ndiani,’] ndiani? Ndatanga imimi.” Woti, “Haa nda’ndafunga kuti ndokwanisa kugarisana—Asi munondida here?” “Ehe ndokudai.” “Nda’ndafunga kuti ndokwanisa kugarisana nanhingi.” Woti, “Chindinyengerai.” [Congregation laughs.] Sister ivavo voenda voti, “Ini nda—izvozvi zvaunoona ndiri pano ndatowana. Chamisa ndechekuti tashaiwa wechichi…? [Congregation says, ‘wechi two,’] kuti tiende kuMurevhi.”

entries.title: The Glory That Excelleth (1)
entries.text: [Congregation laughs.] Ndatongoona kuti ndo’nyaya kwayo iyoyo iyi, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] because tiri kuchengeta vanhu mudzimba dzedu vasingatende ba…? [ Congregation says, “barika,”] barika. Havasi kuritenda. Imagine masisters atiri kugara nawo pana apa, half of the sisters who stay here don’t want it. Havadi, hanzi, “Haa, haa inini…” Uno—ukamutaurira kuti iwe haudi barika anotanga kutsanangura, “Haa I don’t mind barika. Ndendisingadiwo rimwewo barika randisingade, ende also, haa ini I don’t mind, ndoda kutanga inini kuroorerwa, ndoda kutanga kuroora, vezouya kumashure kwangu, handidi kuenda kumashure.” Chakasiyana chii?

entries.title: The Glory That Excelleth (1)
entries.text: Saka toda kuputsa nyaya yekuti vahosi, kubva nhasi. Toshaya kuti vahosi ndiani, munenge muri chii… ? Tokutiyi ‘mahosi’s’ manje. [Congregation laughs.] Ma’a ‘mahosi’s’ muri vaviri handika, ehe. Hakuchisina ane wake manje wekuti ndini ndakatanga murume, hakuna ane kiremu. Ma’a ‘mahosi’s’. Ehe, nokuti ndakaona kuti iyi nyaya kwaichatisvitsa iyi. Ndaparidza barika ndaano-ne-ne…Mwana wangu mukuru webarika angadei ari Zani. That girl should be how many years now? Thirteen handiti? Ehe. I’ve been preaching polygamy for thirteen years, I still have women in the church, girls in the church and people in my own family, who are anti-polygamy. Ndiudzei kuti zvinoreve chii?

entries.title: The Glory That Excelleth (1)
entries.text: Ndosaka nhasi muchiona, maofficers epaChechi pana apa anotorwa naChitsinde. Muri kuzviona zvinonzwisa tsitsi? Maofficers edu ekutanga akatendeuka, handi’moona, akatora vakadzi vavakaroora vakadzosera kuyi…? [Congregation says, “kumashure,”] kumashure. Huh. Sign yekuti munhu ane Shoko raMwari chaiyochaiyo, mbeu, inotenda the David Marriage, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] the Solomon Marriage, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] muri kuiona here? Vanotenda the Adamic Second Co…? [Congregation says, “Covenant,”] Covenant. Ndo’vanhu vanotenda Shoko raMwari.

entries.title: The Glory That Excelleth (1)
entries.text: Mazhinji aya madenomination aya, handi’moona? They don’t believe those people. Vanhu vamuri kuti vari muMessage, they are not believers. Now, chionai complex yaane mabrother edu. Vaakutarisa kuti tokumbira holy water kuEmmanuel. Kwasara kuenda kuno namatirwa kuyi…? [Congregation says, “Emmanuel,”] kuEmmanuwero. Kwasara kuramba maSpoken Words wotenda chii…? [Congregation says, “Emmanuel,”] Emmanuel. Ini ndakati vanhu ngavaone Emmanuel, not that we believe, I don’t even know their doctrine. Ndongoona sekutika, kunoitwa zvinhu zvinenge zvokuna…? [Congregation says, “zvokunamata,”] pane any other television program. If I see anything better than that I will tell you kuti tarisai ikoko, kana tiri mumba mangu. But I don’t, I don’t even know what they believe. If that man believes in the Name of the Father, Son and the Holy Ghost, I don’t even know. I’ve never heard him talk about…eh, baptizing in Jesus’ what…? [Congregation says, “Name.”] I don’t think he believes that.

entries.title: The Glory That Excelleth (1)
entries.text: Redu Shoko ratakatenda riri pamberi hama. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ngatinamatirei Mwenga udzoreredzwe. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndobasa redu. Ndosaka tikauya pano toda kunamatira Mwenga. Mwenga Mwari ngaudzoreredzwe, Mwenga Mwari ngaudzoreredzwe. Vanhu vasingatende Early Church Structure, vanhu hwai? Ndiyo nheyo, yematangiro akaita Chechi muPe…? [Congregation says, “Pentecost,”] muPentecost. Ndookutanga kwaana Peter. Vana Pouro vaitoenda ikoko, Early Church Structure tinoziva matangiro ayakaita handitika?

entries.title: The Glory That Excelleth (1)
entries.text: But people in the Message, Brother Branham put a book called Taking Sides With Jesus, he put a book called Marriage and Divorce, the brothers don’t want those books. Then vokutii imi hamuzi muMessage. No, I’m tired, yekuti tinoenda kunonyengetedza vanhu vanoramba Shoko riripo chai…? [Congregation says, “Amen/chairo.”] Taking Sides With Jesus iripo here? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Brother Branham vanoti, “Ndaka stadha (to study – ED) maitiro aiita ma Apostles muEarly Church ka?” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Zvikanzi, “Dai tanga tiine nguva ndozvandoda kuti tii…? [Congregation says, ‘tiite.’] Dai takanga tazviita izvi, takaendesa vamwe vanhu kuKenya, taka— vatakatuma…I wish imimi vanhu vasara, maiita system iyo…?” [Congregation says, “iyoyo.”] Did Brother Branham say that? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Do they listen those guys? [Congregation says, “no.”]

entries.title: The Glory That Excelleth (1)
entries.text: But inini ndopandoti…Vanhu vaMwari ka, tinozvinetsa hedu. Ini ndofunga kuti Mwenga wasara ndepano. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] That I argue everywhere I go, kuti the Bride yasara papi…? [Congregation says, “pano,”] pano. Ndosaka muchiona ndisingadi kuenda kunotaura nana brother kuBelvedere kana kuMabelreign, handidi ini! Ndotaurei nemunhu asingatende Taking Sides With Jesus? Bhuku randonzwa kuti, “Aiwa Brother, bhuku iroro iro ka iro, makari misunderstander.” Huh, ah! Wobata Marriage and Divorce, unorinyimwa ukaribvunza kuVoice of what…? [Congregation says, “God.”] Hanzi hatisi kuripa mazuva ano, then ndonomira nemunhu iyeye ndichiti anotenda Message? Nonsense.

entries.title: The Glory That Excelleth (1)
entries.text: Kana isu tisingatende Message, ndoda kuziva vanoitenda yese. Inini ngavandipe Spoken Word randisingatendi, one. Handidi quote, ndoda bhuku. Marriage and Divorce iquote? [Congregation says, “mm-mh.”] Ichii? [Congregation says, “ibhuku.”] Taking Sides With Jesus iquote? [Congregation says, “mm-mh.”] Ichii? [Congregation says, “ibhuku.”] Ivo vanotii, “Pane quote yakati ya1969, poita imwe quote yakati ya1959, poita imwe quote ya1956, haisi book yaive audio tape, then kune imwe audio tape ya1939.” Iwe! Rega kundinetsa nematape nemaaudio, ndati bhuku iri, rinoti kudii? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] I’m willing to sit in a classroom with brethren and study that book sentence by what…? [Congregation says, “sentence.”]

entries.title: The Glory That Excelleth (1)
entries.text: Ko imi mabrother imimi, why do you follow a thing blindly, imi masisters imimi? Why do you consider yourself Bride material, bhuku reMarriage and Divorce munaro handitika? Hindava usingariverengi? Wega. Kana uri munhu anononoka kunzwisisa, verenga page, wozorora. [Congregation laughs.] Mangwana woenda wonovhura page yechingani…? [Congregation says, “yechi two,”] wozorora. Rinzwisise. Ukanzwa Brother Branham vachizvitaura, stop talking nonsense. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Iti I’m a believer of the Message. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: The Glory That Excelleth (1)
entries.text: Ndosaka inini vanhu vaMwari handi’moona, vanhu vazhinji vamunoti vari muMessage ka, munonditambisira nguva yangu. Ini ndaona kuti kuita polite for too long hakuzi kutibatsira. [Congregation says, “mm-hmm/Amen.”] People are being too… (Inaudible 0:36:54.1), those brothers are not believing nothing. Tirikuita varume vakuru, vari kutiza vachipinda kwaana Chitsinde, kutiza kuenda kunopinda kwaana Chitsinde.

entries.title: The Glory That Excelleth (1)
entries.text: Zvino chindiudzai kuti kana mu—paine mu—varume vari kunetswa mudzimba dzavo, nevakadzi nenyaya yeMarriage and Divorce, ine vana twenty-four, vaPastor venyu, twenty-four children, the first born would have been thirteen what…? [Congregation says, “years,”] years. I’m getting into twenty years preaching Marriage and Divorce with unbelievers in my church. Then I go on to wed single sisters kumabrothers, single brothers who are also questioning Marriage and Divorce after twenty years of message preaching ne—we—yeMarriage and Divorce, I’m tired. Izvozvo handichada. Hanzi, “… vane nzeve dzekunzwa ngavanzwe…” [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: The Glory That Excelleth (1)
entries.text: Ndosaka ndakati—namata ini kuna Mwari, kuti, “Mwari, inini barika ndariona rakajeka. Riri pachena iri. Barika riri pachena, barika ndiri kuriona. Ndariona barika iri kairi, ini ndicharoora ndakasununguka because, ndine kutenda kwekuti vanhu marambiro avari kuita Shoko ava,” ndo yaive attitude yangu, “ndichasara ndisina vanhu. But kana ndasara ndisina vanhu, ndoda kusara ndiine vana vangu nemadzimai angu.” Ende mungati Mwari aramba kundideera, Iye achikupa yard yakadai, obva aunza Chechi ipapo hm? Handi’moona kuti Mwari adaira, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] kuti zvauri kuda ndazvisimbisa, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] bereka vana vanozara chechi inoyi. Ndoenda uku kunenge kwagara ma—zvivana zvangu zvikomana, vanenge vakura vana Tito madhikoni ava, ndichiti, “Vana vangu, you are the continuation of the seed of righteousness. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hm. Nyika haizive zvatiri kuita izvi, but honai kuropafadzwa kwatiri kudii…? Honai hutano hwatiina…?” [Congregation says, “hwatiinawo.”]

entries.title: The Glory That Excelleth (1)
entries.text: Handina mubvunzo nezvandakaitirwa naMwari mukati moupenyu hwangu. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Iye zvino ndogara ndakagara pasi ndichinyatsoona kuti, why, why did God do this? Why did He do this? He did this for one reason. Ndini munhu angadei ari chiseko chenyika pavarume pandakaparidza (Inaudible 0:38:49). Vanhu vanga vakamirira kundidii…? [Congregation says, “kundiseka,”] kundiseka, but who is laughing back now?

entries.title: The Glory That Excelleth (1)
entries.text: Iye zvino vanhu vanongouya pano, “Aah nzvimbo ino ihombe vakomana hayi! Haa! Yard yenyu yakakura vakomana.” Anongonyarara, akatarisa aone mota, obva ati haa! Atarise aone zimba racho kwar-kwarinoperera haakudii…? haakuwoni, dzimwe dziri kumusana. Anongoona…aone vakuru vacho vouya zvavo vari kutodembedza dumbu, kuzotenga chibage, Josefa muEgypita. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hebhuwereni yakararama pano. [Apostle laughs.] Haina kurarama here pano Mebhoraini? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tichiunza ten tonnes muno umu kuzara kudai vanhu vachitenga chibage, mombe nemombe zvese nechibage, apa une barika revakadzi hobho. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Wapedza izvozvo woenda kuno feed-a nherera paChe…? [Congregation says, “paChechi.”] He? Chirikadzi paChechi, masingle sisters, masingle brothers. No. Tinofanira kusimudza maoko edu kuna Mwari. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ehe.Tinofanira kusimudza maoko edu kuna Mwari zuva rimwe nei…? [Congregation says, “nerimwe,”] tichitenda Mwari nekunaka kwavo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Handi’moona.

entries.title: The Glory That Excelleth (1)
entries.text: Ndosaka anenge abva brother, vatakanzi tinonamata navo Mwari anovaziva. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Haikona kunetseka nemunhu abva. Netseka nezvaunodya, Shoko raMwari rauri kudzidzi…? [Congregation says, “kudzidziswa.”] Ndosaka Mwenga uri pano. Kutambura kwatiri kuita uku ndiSatan uyu. Haazi kuda kuti tiwane nhaka yezvinhu zvedu. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndosaka muri kuona mari iri kunonoka, but ndiri kukukumbirai vanhu vaMwari, hatirambei takakumbira mari. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mwari toda kuvaka machechi. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] By the time I get to sixty years, that’s seven years from now, handitika, tofanira kunge taita a lot of things. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Patinozorova seventy, zvikoro nezvipatara zvinofanira kunge zvavapo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Handi’maona? Pandinozorova eighty, it’s an accepted norm in the whole of Zimba…? [Congregation says, “Zimbabwe.”] Tine vhizhini varanda vaMwari. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: The Glory That Excelleth (1)
entries.text: Mwenga warasika. Vana aChitsinde vakuzivikanwa nekuba mafetiraiza. Vana Brother Jeremiah vari kunetsana nenyaya dzokuti todii nenyaya yebarika kana kuri ramba. They are still basic. Vari pamafirst steps chai…? [Congregation says, “chaiwo.”] People are talking muchechi mavo. Nhasi Mufundisi Jeremiah a…ne madzimai maviri ane pamuviri pake muchechi, aakunzi abvisiwe. Ini ndine vana twenty-four, mukuru wacho angadei ane thirteen what…? [Congregation says, “years,”] years. Ichiri nyaya iyoyo yekunetsana nevanhu nhasi muchechi? Mukuona kuti kuramba Shoko raMwari ka uku? [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: The Glory That Excelleth (1)
entries.text: VaChitsinde vachingoti, “Ndini ndega ndasara mu Message.” Wasara uchiitei? [Congregation laughs.] Uchiba fetiraiza nematractor. Titeedzere izvozvo? Zvino tese tinowana here mukana wekuba mafetiraiza iwayo? Tichibira hurumende yedu, yavapamabvi ayo ka…? [Congregation says, “kare,”] kare nesanction. Any human being would not do that. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] That man Mugabe is not a Christian, he’s a Roman Catholic handitika? But that man…I would rather stand naVaMugabe than naVaChitsinde, hm, paprinciple chaipochaipo.

entries.title: The Glory That Excelleth (1)
entries.text: VaMugabe vakachengeta mamasses zvisingadii…? [Congregation says, “zvisingaite.”] Up to now we don’t know if that man ever stoled anything… (Inaudible 0:42:17) from the masses. Akakupayi mafetiraiza, akakupayi mbeu, akakuunzirayi free education, akakuunzirayi free hospitals, akaisa migwagwa mumarural chii…? [Congregation says, “areas,”] areas. Akakugadzirirayi maruzevha enyu mukaaita magrowth point akaita matowns, akaunza iyi, eh…black empo…? [Congregation says, “empowerment,”] empowerment, he? Akakupai minda, akakupai migodhi, then varungu vakamusabotag-a. (to sabotage – ED).

entries.title: The Glory That Excelleth (1)
entries.text: Then there comes a minister of the Gospel, who claims to be the Bride material, he takes a man with such an effort, yokusimudza the majority of Zimbabwean nation, you…you pull a rug under his feet, iye achipa vanhu zvi—matractor, he. Achipa vanhu magejo, you pull his, he, kuwisira pai…? [Congregation says, “pasi,”] pasi. Then you preach the Gospel in the Name of Jesus, and you tell me to stop preaching polygamy, nonsense. Hm. Vanhu vakandipa mukana wekuti nditaure, baba vayavayaka, handitika? Kunyariwa kuno—hakusi kuvabatsira zvacho…? [Congregation says, “zvachose.”] Time to call a spade a spade, is enough. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: The Glory That Excelleth (1)
entries.text: Inini, I accept my title they gave me, they called me an adulterer, because I preached polygamy. Then let’s tell us, what’s name do we give a man who steals tractors, fertilisers and soya beans from the government? So, does that Bible say adulterers don’t go to heaven then thieves go? Adulterers don’t go into the Rapture, but thieves are raptured? If I’m going to hell, I’m going with my friend, Chitsinde. [Congregation laughs.] Hatina zvatambosiyana zvacho…? [Congregation says, “zvachose.”] Ehe. But ini manje ndoenda ndakabata, ivo handizivi manje, ini ndoenda ndakabata Spoken Wor…? [Congregation says, “Spoken Word.”]

entries.title: The Glory That Excelleth (1)
entries.text: Ndoenda ndakadai ndoti, “Baba, handizivi kuti nyaya yangu inganzwikewo here? Jehovah ndanga ndiine mubvunzo.” Zvonzi, “Bvunza!” “Makambotuma munhu here Wamaiti Seventh Church Age Messenger kumanineteen forty chakuti uku?” [Congregation laughs.] Mwari vanozviona kuti ndakadhisivhiwa, (to be deceived – ED) handi mazviona? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mm. Zvonzi, “Hongu.” Ndoti, “Ha—Ndandichikumbira kuziva kuti wainzani uyu Seventh Church Age Messenger?” Zvonzi, “Ndakatuma munhu anonzi William Marion Branham, aripo here pana apa?” William Marrion Branham onzi, “Ehe, ari among the seven Angels idzo dziri apo idzi.” Honzi, “Hookay.” “Handizivi kuti takanzwisisa here bhuku iri? Ndopane nyaya ye…? Ndopane nyaya yedu yese isusu, patakarasika napo. Anongova maviri andaka kanganisika nawo.” [Apostle and Congregation laughs.]

entries.title: The Glory That Excelleth (1)
entries.text: VaChitsinde pafetiraiza vanonoti kudii? Vanenge vakabata bhuku ripi? Getting Rich Fast, riripo? [Congregation laughs.] Quick Benefits in a Black Empowerment Community; Quick Benefits; Short Cuts to Tractors and Fertilisers by Malachi 4:5. Vanhu vaMwari, imimi munozvitora lightly because hamumbodzikisi pfungwa dzenyu handitika? Hakuna munhu anofunga angadei achiteerera zvinotaura vanhu vekwaChitsi…? [Congregation says, “Chitsinde.”] You should be able to stand up and tell them that I don’t listen to people who are—unomuterera iwewe uri…

entries.title: The Glory That Excelleth (1)
entries.text: “Iwewe horaiti wati Pastor vangu imhombwe, ko imimi munoparidzirwa nembavha? Imi hamuparidzirwi nembavha?” “Haa vakaframe-wa.” (to be framed – ED) “Hooo vakaframe-wa asi Brother Gumbura, ndovaune confirmation, wakainvestigat-a wakaconfirm-a kuti haizi framing?” “Ah, hanti vanobuda pachena vachiparidza barika?” Woti, “Hoo saka barika harimo muShoko raMwari? Dhavhidhi yaive mhombwe here?” Handi’mukuona kuti a—unenge waakubvunza? “Shamwari, haikona kutaura zvausingazivi. Murume akanga akaita saBrother Gumbura muBhaibheri tinovawana vakawa…? [Congregation says, ‘vakawanda,’] ende machapter avakanyora muBhaibheri ari…?” [Congregation says, “arimo.”] Ehe. “Tikaenda tikanoona Dhavhidha akanyora maPisarema, tikanoona Solomon akanyora Proverbs but I don’t know of anyone who stole and wrote nothing in the Bible. I don’t know of anyone, akatorwa example na—Vanhu vaMwari ngatinyengeterei kudzoreredzwa. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: The Glory That Excelleth (1)
entries.text: Ndosaka persecution yatiri kuita go through, inini I enjoy the persecution I am going through, I enjoy it, every bit of it. I enjoy it, because it's nothing to the glory that I will enjoy. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] And I don’t care about what they say these people, security yangu is believing in the Word of Go…? [Congregation says, “of God,”] God, in the Bible. Hativerengei vaRoma, chapter 8. Verse 14. Toda Ameni munhu wese. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] VaRoma chapter 8 verse 14, Ameni tese. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hativerengei, Ameni tese. Verse 14 tese: For as many as are led by the Spirit of God they are the sons of God.

entries.title: The Glory That Excelleth (1)
entries.text: “…as many as are led by the Spirit of God are the…?” [Congregation says, “sons of God.”] [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Zvekuti munhu anoda kuti mukwane mupfungwa dzake, hazvisi right. Munhu ngaakuregerei muchitungamirirwa noMweya waani…? [Congregation says, “waMwari.”] Kana Mweya waMwari uri iwo wakaparidza Marriage and Divorce, vanotungamirirwa noMweya, Marriage and Divorce vanoyite…? [Congregation says, “vanoyitenda.”] Kana Mweya waMwari uri iwo wakaparidza Taking Sides With Jesus, vanotungamirirwa neMweya, Taking Sides with Jesus vanoyidii…? [Congregation says, “vanoyitenda.”]

entries.title: The Glory That Excelleth (1)
entries.text: Ende vese vanotungamirirwa noMweya havagamuchiri, vanhu vanoba. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Kuba kuri wrong. Barika, right! Kuba, wrong! Hapana debate panyaya iyoyo. Kuba hakuparidzwi muShoko raMwari, hakuna bhuku, hakuna justification. Hapana paunoona panonzi iba, hapana! But kuroora vakadzi vaviri kana vatatu kunobvumirwa neShoko raMwari. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Saka vanotungamirirwa noMweya, vana vaMwari. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Security yedu Mweya waani…? [Congregation says, “waMwari,”] ende tinotungamirirwa noMwe…? [Congregation says, “noMweya,”] kwete nemaleaders, anoramba Shoko masikati machenachena iye achityora Shoko achiba, but woramba Spoken Word raakaisa mu-mu shelf maani…? [Congregation says, “make,”] make, woyedza kuridudzira, hatiiti izvozvo.

entries.title: The Glory That Excelleth (1)
entries.text: Ndonyaya yakaita kuti vanhu varoverere Ishe Jeso Kristu. Caiaphas airatidzwa pachenachena kuti, “Uda kurovera Jesu Kristo, but Bhaibhiri riri kutaura kuti kuchauya munhu uyu, mhandara Maria ichabereka mwa…? [Congregation says, ‘mwana.’] Ndiye ka uyu.” Iye oramba. John we—uyu the Baptist wamuri kunetsa uyu, ndiye akanzika uyu naIsaiah, “A voice crying in the wil…?” [Congregation says, “wilderness.”]

entries.title: The Glory That Excelleth (1)
entries.text: Serpent seed rejects, the Word that is written. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Muri kupabata here varanda vaMwari? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Serpent seed inoramba Shoko raMwari rakanyorwa pachena-chena chai…? [Congregation says, “chaipo.”] Ndozvazvakaita serpent seed yeku-ye-yemunguva yaIshe Jesu Kristu, vairamba Spoken Word. Iye zvino m denomination, vari kuramba pachena-chena Malachi 4 what…? [Congregation says, “5.”] Vanoiramba iripo Malachi 4:5, they don’t want to hear about it. Vanotenda kuti Brother Branham havana kutumwa, he is a false prophet, but, it’s written and has been confirmed, and a picture with a pillar of fire, everybody saw it, but they don’t want him.

entries.title: The Glory That Excelleth (1)
entries.text: Nhasi uno brother, barika riri muBhaibhiri, barika, madenomination ari kuri ra…? [Congregation says, “kuri ramba.”] Vanhu vari munyika vari kuridii…? [Congregation says, “kuri ramba.”] Hurumende dziri kuridii…? [Congregation says, “kuri ramba.”] Why? Ndosaka muChechi medu vanhu vaMwari ngatiregerei kuramba tichinyengetedza kugara nevanhu. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Zviri better kunamata muripo ten but muchitenda zvinhu zvimwe...? [Congregation says, “zvimwe chete,”] pane kurarama ma—takawanda kudai, but half vari muno vari kuti barika hatidi, half vari kuti tinoda. Huh. Ngavaendeka kwaChitsinde kwacho. Why do you remain uri pano? Ukazonzwa matauriro avanoita vachituka vazodziwa vaMwari, hanzi, “…they speak evil of digni…?” [Congregation says, “dignities/dignitaries.”] Wadii wati Mwari ndiitireiwo nyasha manheru anhasi. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Handidi kuremerwa neMarriage and Divorce, handidi kuremerwa neTaking Sides with Je…? [Congregation says, “Jesus.”] Handidi kuremerwa newritten Word, handidi. Handei paverse 15 tone tese. Verse 15 hativerengei tose: For ye have not received the spirit of bondage again to fear but ye have received the Spirit of adoption, whereby we cry, Abba, Father.

entries.title: The Glory That Excelleth (1)
entries.text: Muri kupaonaka? Tagamuchira mweya wokugadzwa, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] watinotaura naMwari masikati machena. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Handei mberi. The Spirit itself beareth witness with our spirit, that we are the children of God:

entries.title: The Glory That Excelleth (1)
entries.text: [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hatiitei Ameni varanda vaMwari. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Right. Ndoda kuti mutaure mose, ngatidzokororei, hanzi, “Mweya, [Congregation says, ‘Mweya,’] unotipupurira, [Congregation says, ‘unotipupurira,’] kuti tiri vana vaMwari,” [Congregation says, “kuti tiri vana vaMwari,”] kwete dzimwe chechi. [Congregation says, “kwete dzimwe chechi.”] [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndoda Ameni ipapo hama. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndoda Ameni akadarika ipa…? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hazvina kumbonzi munopupurirwa nechechi yekwaChe— yekwaJeremiah, kana munopupurirwa yekwaChitsinde, kana munopupurirwa nechechi yekwaChesa.

entries.title: The Glory That Excelleth (1)
entries.text: Mweya waMwari mauri uri kukuudza kuti uri chii? Chakuti uuye kuno uku nhasi kuChechi chii? [Congregation says, “Mweya waMwari.”] Mweya waMwari? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Chiri kukuita kuti uenjoy-e (to enjoy - ED) Shoko raMwari chii? [Congregation says, “Mweya waMwari.”] Chinokuita kuti urare wanamata chii? [Congregation says, “Mweya waMwari.”] Chinokuverengesa Bhaibhiri chii? [Congregation says, “Mweya waMwari.”] Chinokuti pupura chii? [Congregation says, “Mweya waMwari.”] So where do you bring in all these churches, Belvedere, Mabelreign and all that? Where do you bring them? Mweya waMwari ngaukupupurire hama. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: The Glory That Excelleth (1)
entries.text: Sei ini ndiine Shumiro yandiinayo nhasi? Ndinoziva kuti Shumiro ya…? ndeyaMwari, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] nokuti Mwari vanondipa chapupu chekuti ndiri mwana waMwari. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndoovanonditi ndiparidze zvandiri kuparidza izvo…? [Congregation says, “izvozvo.”] And He gives me good health, He gives me transport, He gives me accommodation, He gives me Church, He makes people born again, He cast away de…? [Congregation says, “devils.”] He changes people’s lives. The Spirit of God in our midst, bears me witness. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] What more do yo—I want?

entries.title: The Glory That Excelleth (1)
entries.text: Jesus came and stood in the midst of the Pharisees vamuramba, zvikanzi “Iwewe wakazvarwa neupo…? [Congregation says, ‘neupombwe,’] and uri Bhirizabhabhu the prince of what…? devils.” Zvikanzi, “You receive testimony and witness of…? of men. I don’t need testimony of men and witness, hm, …the Spirit of God beareth Me witness that I’m a child of what…? [Congregation says, ‘of God,’] …and go and read your Scriptures, they are they which speak of Me.” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Jeso Kristu havana kukwanisa kuwana kana chechi one yekunongedzera kuti endai munonzwa kuti vanotaura zvakanaka pamusoro pangu, vakati Magwaro anotaura pamusoro paani…? [Congregation says, “pangu.”] Vakati, “Mweya waMwari unondipupurira. Mabasa, hanzi mabasa andinodii…? [Congregation says, ‘andino bata,’] they bear me witness kuti ndiri Mwana wani…?” [Congregation says, “waMwari.”] Hallelujah, Hallelujah! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen! [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: The Glory That Excelleth (1)
entries.text: Ndosaka isusu vanhu vaMwari tinopupurirwa handi’moona, neMweya waMwari uri mai…? [Congregation says, “matiri.”] Ukateerera vanhu, dai ndakateerera vanhu kunzi handinamati handinamati, ndakaregera kudha…? [Congregation says, “kuudhara.”] Ehe. Vamwe vaitaura kuti Pastor havanamati vari Botswana, Pastor havanamati vari Zambia, Pastor havanamati vari Joburg, Pastor havanamati vari Britain, Pastor havanamati vari Ireland, but all those who were saying Pastor havanamati vamwe vacho they are now back sli…? [Congregation says, “back slidden.”] What was he that was chucking in there? But here I am now, tiri kuronga kuvaka makereke, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] ende tichaavaka here makereke aya hama? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ah, tinovaka makereke. Tichaiwana here mari iyi? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] God said, “…I’ll provide all your needs in Christ Jesus.” [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: The Glory That Excelleth (1)
entries.text: Zvino womira kuti, “Hee toda kugamuchirwa nana Brother Mudekwa.” Vanokugamuchira? “Toda kugamuchirwa naBrother Musharu.” Anoti “Buda kwauri kupinda.” “Toda kugamuchirwa naMadhovi.” He. If you want to join the club tanga wadyiswa. [Congregation laughs.] Mupfuhwira unovapupurira kuti vana vaMwari. [Apostle and Congregation laughs.] Ndozvataura Shoko raMwari, he? Munhu pupurirwa noMweya waMwari hama. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ehe, pupurirwa noMweya waMwari.

entries.title: The Glory That Excelleth (1)
entries.text: Inini handimbofa ndakazeza kutaura Shoko randinotenda iri. I live, for God, I believe the Word of…? [Congregation says, “God,”] God, and it would be a crime for me not to stand for what I believe because, since I preached it, God confirmed it, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] nehutano, nematerial eh…things, handi’muri kuona? Kutendeuka kwevanhu, Chechi yacho kuramba iripo. Hapana chandakamboita ndega, Mwari vai confirm-a vo…? [Congregation says, “voga,”] neconfirmation yekuti muChechi mangu ndinogara ndine madhimoni anondirwisa, but anongozoparara iwo pacha…? [ Congregation says, “pachawo.”] Ini ndosara ndiripo. “Vane nzeve dzekunzwa ngavanzwe, [Congregation says, ‘Amen,’] zvinotaura Mweya kuyi…?” [ Congregation says, “kuKereke.”] Handei mberi tione. Handei mberi tione verse 17 tese: And if children, then heirs; heirs of God, and joint-heirs with Christ; if so be that we suffer with Him, that we may be also glorified together.

entries.title: The Glory That Excelleth (1)
entries.text: Ndoda Alle—Amen kuhama. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndoda Allelujah yakasimba. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndosaka suffering yauri kuita go through brother, handi uri kapanzwisisa ipapo? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Suffering yauri kuita go through it’s nothing to the glory that you shall enjoy. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hatiitei Ameni ipapo hama. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ukanonoka kuroorwa, inyaya iyoyo? Kutsva panyama, isuffering iyoyo, yekuti ungati ndodzokera kumashure nokuti ndanonoka kuroorwa, kana ndashaya aroora? It’s nothing compared to the glory that will come. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Kunonoka kuroora, ndosaka ndiri kuti mabrother, ngatisimudzirei zvinhu zvaMwari kutanga. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Handi tiri kupanzwisisa ipapo vanhu vaMwari, ehe? Hativakei kereke, hatiisirei Mwari zvinhu zvake zvakanaka zvakanaka, ngatiparidzei Vhangeri, ngati safeyi (to suffer – ED) nokuti kubwinya kwacho kuchatevera, aah.

entries.title: The Glory That Excelleth (1)
entries.text: Tiri vadyi venhaka isu, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] naMwari pamwe chete, but you need that character my brother. Mwari vanofanira kukupa character iyoyo yekuti unokwanisa kuti kwete kuzvipfeve, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] kwete kumadhiri ekuba, kwete kuvakomana vemunyika, kwete kufashoni, kwete kumupfuhwira, kwete kuvanhu vano shoropodza barika vachiri tsvinyira vachiriseka, mira naro, nguva yekutora stand yakwana. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndiyo nguva yacho ino yokutora stand kwete gore rinouya kana svondo inouya, now!

entries.title: The Glory That Excelleth (1)
entries.text: Ndosaka ini ndiri kutenda kuti ti—kutambura kwese kwauri kuita iye zvino it’s nothing brother. Kana uchitambura uri muZita raJesu, it’s nothing to the glory you’ll receive. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Not only kudenga but pasi pano zvaka…? [Congregation says, “zvakare.”] [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tingaita Ameni here varanda vaMwari. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tingaita Ameni here akadarika ipapo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ehe, toda Ameni akapfuura ipapo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hativerengei tione. Verse 18. Ndoda Amen zvakare. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hativerengei verse a—verse 18 tese: For I reckon that the sufferings of this present time are not worthy to be compared with the glory which shall be revealed in us.

entries.title: The Glory That Excelleth (1)
entries.text: Ndoda Ameni varanda vaMwari. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Now, glory iyoyo ino reveal-iwa (to be revealed – ED) ma-ma-matirika, it’s not only future tense eternally, no! Even tisati tabva panyika pano, nyika ino ichaona chinonzi vava vaani… ? [Congregation says, “vaMwari.”] Muri kuona kuti…kuti ndikuratidzei kuti haizi eternal, haizi yekuhupenyu hunotevera, verengai verse rinotevera muone kuti iri kurehwa kuti glory yacho ndeya rinhi. Verse 19 ndoda Ameni munhu wese. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndoda Ameni akadarika ipapo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hativerengei verse 19 tese: For the earnest expectation of the creature waiteth for the manifestation of the sons of God.

entries.title: The Glory That Excelleth (1)
entries.text: Tingawana Ameni here varanda vaMwari. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Vari kupi vana vaMwari ivavo? Ndisu vanhu vaMwari. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] “The whole creation is waiting for the manifestation of the sons of…?” [Congregation says, “of God.”] Ndosaka kana vanhu vachitarisira glory yakanyanyisa, handitika, suffering inotofanira kuva yakanya…? [Congregation says, “yakanyanya.”] But whatever suffering yaunoita go through haimbocompayewe (to be compared – ED) neglory yacho ichazote…? [Congregation says, “ichatevera.”]

entries.title: The Glory That Excelleth (1)
entries.text: Apo panoda nyasha apa. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Muri kupanzwisisaka varanda vaMwari? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Panoda nyasha kuti izvozvo uzvi nzwisi…? [Congregation says, “nzwisise.”] Unopinda musuffering, unogona kushaiwa mari, kunonoka kuroora, kunonoka kuroorwa, zvinhu kusakufambira zvakanaka, but ramba wakatsunga because glory yaucha manifest-a inoita out do suffering yauri kuita go…? [Congregation says, “go through.”] Security yedu Mweya waMwari uri matiri. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Security imota here? Security dzimba here? Zivo yekuti tiri vana vaani…? [Congregation says, “vaMwari.”]

entries.title: The Glory That Excelleth (1)
entries.text: Ndosaka ndichiti mumwe nemumwe ari pano vanhu vaMwari, ngatiendei mumuteuro varanda vaShe. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Kuteurira Mwenga we…? [Congregation says, “wese,”] nekuti isusu ndisu tichaita kuti Mwenga uone, kubwinya kwakatumwa kuKereke yaMwari, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] nekuti tatoona kudhara maitiro ari kuita zvinhuka? Vakatumwa kuti varatidze kubwinya kunofanira kuva muMwenga, ndisu. Ndosaka iwe neni manje ngatitangei kunamatira double portion iyaiya. Ngatinamatirei one accord i…? Tsiura mweya yemayi…? [Congregation says, “yemadzinza.”] Tsiura mweya yepo…? [Congregation says, “yepoverty.”]

entries.title: The Glory That Excelleth (1)
entries.text: Rega kutya kutendeuka. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ehe. Ndozvandaitaura ndikati mukatarisa, tarirai vana Brother Dube, kubva zvavaenda kuSouth Africa, muri kuona kuti havasisipo nhasi? But pavanga varipo mofunga kuti vaifunga kuti vanenge vasisipo nhasi? Vaitofunga kuti vacha enjoy-a BM yavo iyi kwenguva yakare…? [Congregation says, “yakareba,”] yakareba. Vaitofunga kuti ndichatovaka imba yangu kuKwekwe, vakadira slab, handitika? Vaiti vachatovaka kuimba yangu kuKwekwe ndotopedza but look what has happened. Mwari haakoshese program yako iri personal, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] but security huru kuisa pfungwa dzako muzvinhu zvaMwari. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Unogona kuti ndoda kuchengeta imba yangu, ndoda kuchengeta imba, wotya kutendeuka zvawakafamba mazviri, imba yacho uchangorasikirwa nayo che…? [Congregation says, “chete.”] “Handidi kutendeuka zvakati, Pastor vanozondivenga, handidi kutendeuka zvakati Pastor vanozo…” Brother, uchazongorasikirwa nezvauri kutya izvo…? [Congregation says, “izvozvo.”] Zvauri kutya kazhinji ndozvinoitika kwa…? [Congregation says, “kwauri.”]

entries.title: The Glory That Excelleth (1)
entries.text: Mwari vakatiunzira muno muHarare vanhu vaMwari, kuti Mwenga, udzoreredzwe zvakare, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] ende vachashandiswa kuita basa iroro ndiwe naani…? [Congregation says, “neni.”] Ministry yedu hainzwisisike.
